subject: Risk & Compliance
title: The UK Governance Code
description: Learn The UK Governance Code in one minute.

hook.text: The UK doesn't mandate governance rules. Instead it uses 'comply or explain' — follow the code or say why you don't.

buildup.text: The UK Corporate Governance Code sets best practices for boards, pay, audit, and risk management.

discovery.text: Companies must explain any deviations in their annual reports. Investors decide if the explanation is acceptable.

twist.text: Comply or explain is flexible but only works when investors actually read and challenge the explanations.

climax.text: The UK model influenced governance codes in over 70 countries. Principles-based beats prescriptive for many.

punchline.text: Follow the code or explain why not. 70 countries copied it.

quiz.question: How does the UK governance code work?
options: Companies comply or explain deviations publicly
Companies must follow every rule without exception
The government approves all board decisions
